summary: migrateSessionsFromAgentRoot() in packages/coding-agent/src/migrations.ts aborted the whole batch with `return` when a legacy session file collided with an already-migrated session of the same name. It now uses `continue`, so only the colliding file is skipped (both copies preserved) and every later file in the batch still migrates; malformed headers remain untouched and reruns are idempotent.
changes: packages/coding-agent/src/migrations.ts: in migrateSessionsFromAgentRoot(), replaced `if (existsSync(newPath)) return;` with `if (existsSync(newPath)) continue;` (plus a clarifying comment) so a name collision skips only that file instead of ending the migration loop.
.prale-eval/regression.mjs: standalone Node assertion script that loads the real module via .prale-eval/subject.mjs with real fs/path and a temporary agentDir.

validation.notes: Ran from the workspace root on Node v24.14.0; exits 0 with 'regression ok: collision skipped, remaining batch migrated, malformed header untouched, reruns idempotent'. The script creates a temporary agentDir inside .prale-eval/ containing well-formed legacy session files plus one malformed header, probes readdirSync order so a colliding entry is always processed before at least one later file, pre-creates the colliding target copy with different bytes, and then runs the real migrateSessionsFromAgentRoot(). Assertions: (1) the colliding source file is still present in the agent root with byte-identical content; (2) the pre-existing migrated copy is unchanged (both copies preserved, no overwrite); (3) every file that followed the collider in the batch was moved into sessions/--<encoded-cwd>--/ with its content intact; (4) the malformed-header file is untouched; (5) exactly four session files exist under sessions/ (nothing lost); (6) a second and third run leave the whole tree byte-identical (idempotent). Fault detection was verified by temporarily reverting the one-line fix: the script then fails with 'AssertionError: legacy-2.jsonl should have been migrated out of the agent root despite the earlier collision' and exit code 1, and passes again with the fix restored. No dependencies or network were used; temporary fixtures are removed in a finally block.
